known_limitations: The 180 second run does not cover the complete tunnel world.
The final semantic planner remains behind original TARE on all four 180 second exploration metrics.
Underground validation is trajectory-disjoint inside tunnel and garage, not held-out underground-world validation.
The dataset field exit_sector_soft is elementwise identical to direction_traversable, so it is not an independent exit supervision signal.
Continuous reachable-distance prediction remains partly observation-horizon sensitive and must not independently create topology nodes.

diagnosis.model: Local connection semantics are useful but not yet proven to generalize to an unseen underground world; direction error is the dominant role error source.
diagnosis.mapper: Rotation alignment, causal semantic smoothing and structural-event-only insertion fixed the major node-density error.
diagnosis.planner: Graph backtracking works, but frontier utility and route efficiency remain substantially weaker than TARE.
